scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with tall buildings lining both sides, featuring a mix of modern and older structures, including a large glass-fronted building on the right side of the street, with a yellow-painted section in the middle of the road for cyclists and motorcyclists to ride through, surrounded by trees and streetlights along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are primarily beige-colored, with some having a more modern aesthetic, while others have a more traditional look, with varying heights and window styles.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt, with a yellow-painted section in the middle of the road for cyclists and motorcyclists to ride through, and features a mix of concrete and brick pavers on the sidewalks.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and bike racks along the sidewalk, providing a place for pedestrians and cyclists to rest and store their bikes.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The street is lined with trees, adding shade and greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including directional signs and informational signs, but most are illegible due to distance and angle.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, some stopping to chat or take photos, while others continue on their way.
scene_analysis.as_resident: A few locals can be seen going about their daily business, enjoying the pleasant weather.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is bustling with activity, with cars, buses, and bicycles sharing the road with pedestrians.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is a hub of activity, with people from all walks of life coming together to enjoy the sights and sounds of the city.
scene_analysis.as_student: Students and commuters alike can be seen walking to and from school or work, taking advantage of the convenient location.
